pli-tv-bu-vb-pc66:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc66:1.2: tena kho pana samayena aññataro sattho rājagahā paṭiyālokaṃ gantukāmo hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc66:1.10: athakho te kammikā taṃ satthaṃ gahetvā acchinditvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavocuṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc66:1.11: kissa tvaṃ bhante jānaṃ theyyasatthena saddhiṃ gacchasīti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc66:1.13: athakho so bhikkhu sāvatthiṃ gantvā bhikkhūnaṃ etamatthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc66:1.14: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc66:1.15: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhu jānaṃ theyyasatthena saddhiṃ saṃvidhāya ekaddhānamaggaṃ paṭipajjissatīti …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc66:1.16: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ bhikkhu jānaṃ theyyasatthena saddhiṃ saṃvidhāya ekaddhānamaggaṃ paṭipajjasīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc66:1.19: hi nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa jānaṃ theyyasatthena saddhiṃ saṃvidhāya ekaddhānamaggaṃ paṭipajjissasi
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc66:1.20: netaṃ moghapurisa appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya pasannānaṃ vā bhiyyobhāvāya …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc66:1.21: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc66:1.22.1: yo pana bhikkhu jānaṃ theyyasatthena saddhiṃ saṃvidhāya ekaddhānamaggaṃ paṭipajjeyya antamaso gāmantarampi pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc66:2.1.6: sāmaṃ vā jānāti aññe vā tassa ārocenti so vā āroceti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc66:2.1.8: corā katakammā vā honti akatakammā vā rājānaṃ vā theyyaṃ gacchanti suṅkaṃ vā pariharanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc66:2.1.12: gacchāmāvuso gacchāma bhante gacchāma bhante gacchāmāvuso ajja vā hiyyo vā pare vā gacchāmāti saṃvidahati āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc66:2.1.14: kukkuṭasampāte gāme gāmantare gāmantare āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc66:2.1.15: agāmake araññe aḍḍhayojane aḍḍhayojane āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc66:2.2.1: theyyasatthe theyyasatthasaññī saṃvidhāya ekaddhānamaggaṃ paṭipajjati antamaso gāmantarampi āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc66:2.2.2: theyyasatthe vematiko saṃvidhāya ekaddhānamaggaṃ paṭipajjati antamaso gāmantarampi āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc66:2.2.3: theyyasatthe atheyyasatthasaññī saṃvidhāya ekaddhānamaggaṃ paṭipajjati antamaso gāmantarampi anāpatti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc66:2.2.4: bhikkhu saṃvidahati manussā na saṃvidahanti āpatti dukkaṭassa.
